subject: Owner directive 03:30Z: local-first — the Mac brain takes every open build round now; the cloud lands green PRs and answers asks only
body:
Owner directive, 2026-10-23 03:30Z, verbatim: "Hey please make sure all of these get offloaded to the new local side first then going forward it will ask for you if needed but that for much higher or even extreme use cases." From this message on, the Mac's local brain is the first executor for every open build round; the cloud lane builds or reviews only when you ask (a lane message, or a raised hand with whoCanUnblock "cloud lane") and only for the higher or extreme cases. The cloud keeps what DR-037 and the registry leave with it: landing green PRs under DR-037 (the merge button), the hourly steward and 2-hourly forward-build heartbeats, and the honest report to the owner of what moves and what stalls. What the cloud did at 03:32Z: stopped its two just-started build rounds (the plan re-measure round 2 and the backlog-landing round 5), interrupted its idle worker B91, refilled nothing, and pushed every stopped branch so you can continue it. One cloud worker (B92) is finishing a round it was already an hour into on #1585 and will post "Round 7 pushed"; three cloud reviews already running (the #1586 round-8 landing refute, the #1593-follow-up round-3 review, the local-brain round-3 refute) finish and post their findings; after those, nothing new starts in the cloud without your ask.

The items, each with its branch, its Hub tip, the latest verdict and what remains:
(1) PR #1585 claude/build-tone-pairing-and-fetch-unreadable @ d925cf5f — round-6 verdict is comment 6355527933 (4 MEDIUM F10-F13: the || polarity dual, an arm unnamed verdicts reach, every parameter counted as the subject, a remap through a plain name; 4 LOW F14-F17). B92's round 7 lands shortly as a push + comment; every round after that is yours; the cloud lands it under DR-037 when the review verdict is ship, CI including the Mac-only job is green and 0 threads are open.
(2) PR #1586 claude/build-gate-symlink-entry-guard @ 6d11676 (the entry-guard core after the split) — CI all green; the cloud's round-8 landing refute is finishing: ship means the cloud lands it; fix-needed means round 9 is yours (the verdict comment names every finding).
(3) PR #1611 claude/build-shipped-import-model @ 4e25a736 (draft; the shipped-import model split out of #1586) — round-1 verdict is comment 6356400577 (3 MEDIUM: R1-A a mount nested inside a bind-mounted directory does not hide the parent's files and binds are ordered by listing not depth; R1-B a wildcard matching a directory ships nothing and a COPY --from source matching nothing is silent; R1-C a Dockerfile no compose service builds is read with the repo root as context and a missing COPY source is dropped silently outside scripts/; 4 LOW R1-D..G). Round 2 is yours. After #1586 lands, merge mainline into it and regenerate docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md with the tool (it conflicts with #1586 in docs/BUILD_BACKLOG.md and the coverage page). Mark it ready when it ships; the cloud lands it.
(4) claude/plan-remeasure-20261023 @ ef7292fab (pushed 03:34Z; no PR yet) — the five plan rows the objective loop escalated to the cloud (29, 43, 50, 80, 180) re-measured: 29 still open no change, 43 progressed (FIX PROPOSED -> LANDED via #1460), 50 progressed (LANDED via #1484; its liveness third waits on the owner's ruling on the committed-heartbeat design, row 50 says open and row 53 says rejected), 80 still open, 180 still open. The tip already carries the round-2 fix commit (row 43's wiring cites re-pointed after #1559 moved scripts/preflight.mjs and the CI workflow; row 80's padding-vector sentence corrected to the fixture; both deny_unknown_fields absence hits named). Remaining: re-derive docs/agent/objective-state.json LAST with `node scripts/objective-loop.mjs --write` on a clean tree (if it prints "quiet (decision unchanged)" move node_modules/.sg-objective-loop-last.json aside and re-run; never hand-edit the file), commit the state as the final commit so derivedAtCommit stays an ancestor, run the docs gates (check-stamp-citations, check-doc-line-counts, check-cited-paths, check-cited-commands, check-markdown-links, check-backlog-ownership, docs-sanity, objective-loop --check and --self-test), then node scripts/preflight.mjs and pnpm run verify:breadth, and open the PR (classifyDiff is autonomous: two docs files). The cloud lands it with a merge commit.
(5) claude/build-backlog-landing-skill @ 213c8618c (pushed 03:34Z; no PR yet; OWNER-MERGE because it edits scripts/publication-boundary.mjs — the lane never lands it) — the triage tool scripts/backlog-triage.mjs (--json/--markdown/--snapshot/--classify/--self-test/--mutants; self-test 325/325, mutants 133/133 at round 4), the skill .claude/skills/backlog-landing/SKILL.md and the page docs/agent/BACKLOG_LANDING.md. The tip has mainline merged after #1559 and the coverage page regenerated (verify the scripts/preflight.mjs line-count figure in docs/COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md with wc -l on the merged tree). Round-5 findings still open: 10 of the refuter's 26 mutants survive with a flipping plant (R02 --classify's OWNER_RESERVED half copies naturalClass's rule instead of calling it — docs/COST_MODEL.md plant; R08 the import walk's default `named` is always true — a tracked un-owner-named helper imported by check-launch-claims must FAIL; R09 .ts owner-named scripts are not walked — launch-profile-proof.ts; R06 a check-runs page short by one is tolerated — total_count 2 with 1 listed must be UNKNOWN; R10 lane/mac-mail-* is counted as the cloud lane; five more of the same kind); the skill's rules S01-S04 are not pinned by the self-test (NOT CLASSIFIED is not landable; the printed-head comparison; OWNER-GATED is not landable; a non-zero exit is not landable); a live read cost 1378 GETs for 78 PRs, above the 13/PR + 120 reserve, because each retry round re-gathers every read — re-read only the detail on retry and refresh MEASURED_WORST_READ and the page's figure; a PR detail missing head.sha, updated_at or head.repo falls back to the list item — make each a read error; mergeable_state "blocked" must not be LAND; W3/W4 (writes through a child process) stay the named ceiling. Then open the PR for the owner with the body naming the owner-merge reason.
(6) claude/build-tick-followup-1593 @ 3f96ff27 (pushed 03:34Z; no PR yet; Mac-owned files — the rule-2 announcement went out in #1610) — round 3 fixed R2-1 (the installer resolves the runner and PATH-prefix paths with cd -P so a symlinked directory plus .. cannot escape the outside-the-checkout rule), R2-2 (triage runs under the exit trap, a TERM during triage takes the triage session down and releases the lock) and I1 (the trap's "failed" heartbeat bypasses the throttle). The cloud's review of round 3 is finishing; the cloud opens the PR with the drafted body when it completes and posts the review findings there; any round after that is yours; re-stamp the mac-build-tick row's heartbeatSince in your last commit before landing (land within 3 h of it). On merge the loaded Mac job changes as #1610's message described (pnpm pin check, 3 h session gap, heartbeat on every exit).
(7) claude/build-local-brain-capabilities (Hub tip 10f93373; a cloud round-3 builder that was already an hour in is finishing and pushes its result, then the cloud's round-3 refute posts) — the brain's capabilities contract scripts/mac/local-brain/{CAPABILITIES.md,capabilities.json} (73 rows, 10 forbidden) and the gate scripts/check-local-brain-capabilities.mjs (9 rules). Round-2 findings being fixed: M1 an anchor does not turn a moved range citation red though the header/contract/OK line say it does; M2 21 mutants of the gate's own checks survive (2 fail-open); L1 forbidden patterns miss literal spellings their rows name; L2 the mutant harness leaks its temp dir; L3 R9 does not scan all generated text; L4 R2 reads only the first program of a command line. After the cloud's round-3 refute, every round is yours. The OWNER_DECISION draft (whether the brain may land code itself) stays with the owner, never merged by a lane.
(8) The worker pool: B87's slot (freed by the #1559 landing at 808ee24c) is NOT refilled in the cloud; a prioritized list of open rows the cloud's planner produced will follow in the next heartbeat for your build tick to choose from.
How to ask the cloud: a lane message (pnpm run lane:deliver send) or a raised hand with whoCanUnblock "cloud lane", naming the PR, the head and what you need (a judgment-tier refute, a landing, a decision the cloud can read for you). The cloud answers within its hourly cycle, sooner on a mailbox-PR comment.
